# gtme query

read-only SQL against the ledger; --save stores it as a named segment.

## Forms

```
gtme query "SQL" [--save NAME] [--name NAME] [--list] [--format ndjson|table|csv] [--limit N]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--save` | `NAME` | --save stores it as a named segment. |
| `--name` | `NAME` | See the form. |
| `--list` | nothing | See the form. |
| `--format` | `ndjson|table|csv` | See the form. |
| `--limit` | `N` | See the form. |

It exits with one of the [exit codes](/reference/cli#exit-codes) every verb shares.

## Example

From [Your CSV](/start/my-csv):

```sh
gtme query "SELECT i.identity_key, e.detail ->> 'reason' AS reason
  FROM step_events e JOIN identities i ON i.id = e.identity_id
  WHERE e.step_id = 'fit' AND e.event = 'done' AND e.detail ->> 'pass' = 0"
```
